analogy.rationale: Topical sunscreens act physically/chemically in the skin with negligible systemic exposure and no annotated targets, so they should elicit little to no transcriptional response in these cell lines; the closest listed classes are other topically or inertly acting agents with minimal cellular pathway engagement.
